reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, but re-does the daily-skip vs move-weekend decision that getUpcomingDates already makes instead of extracting it.

duplication.why: The per-occurrence weekend decision (skipsWeekendDays, isWeekend skip, getDateWithSkippedWeekend move) and the RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb scaffold are duplicated from getUpcomingDates in the same file.

placement.why: Handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its type registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and commented, but the weekend rule now lives in yet another copy that must change with getUpcomingDates, getNextDate and schedule-template.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper; no shared per-occurrence weekend function existed to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in schedules/app.ts restates getUpcomingDates' ternary weekend handling as a nested if/continue with a mutable date, reshaped rather than shared.
